page.content:
1940–41 bombing of British cities after the Battle of Britain.

How The Blitz connects

  • Character: Winston Churchill — Churchill's government held through the Blitz.
  • Event: Battle of Britain — The daylight Battle of Britain gave way to the Blitz.

What is The Blitz?

The Blitz was the night campaign against London and other cities when invasion had failed. It did not break British resistance; it fixed Churchill's Britain in Allied memory.

Key threads lead to Winston Churchill and Battle of Britain.
